name: qa-mobile-native
description: Mobile + mobile-web E2E testing: 10 skills covering native (xcuitest-suite, espresso-suite), cross-platform drivers (appium-testing, detox-testing, maestro-flows), Flutter (flutter-testing), device-matrix dispatcher (mobile-device-matrix-toolkit), mobile-web emulation (mobile-web-emulation-runner), touch gesture verification (touch-gesture-tester), mobile Web Vitals budget (mobile-perf-budget). Plus 2 A2 agents: mobile-driver-selector (picks the test framework from project markers) and mobile-test-author (composes the chosen driver skill to emit one test file per spec).
